entries.text: Dosha: One of the three Ayurvedic bio-energies — Vata, Pitta, Kapha (Dravyaguna).
entries.label: Dosha

entries.text: Dosha Action: A statement of how a plant affects a specific Dosha — pairs a Dosha (via onDosha) with a direction (via actionType: Shamaka/Vardhaka).
entries.label: Dosha Action

entries.text: Guna: Ayurvedic quality/attribute (Dravyaguna).
entries.label: Guna

entries.text: Karma: What therapeutic action, medicinal action, or effect this plant has (Karma), per Charaka Samhita.
entries.label: Karma

entries.text: Plant Part: The part of the plant used medicinally. Aligned with Darwin Core / AyurAhaar.
entries.label: Plant Part

entries.text: Plant Species: A medicinal plant taxon. Aligned with dwc:Taxon.
entries.label: Plant Species

entries.text: Rasa: Ayurvedic taste category (Dravyaguna).
entries.label: Rasa

entries.text: Varga: A classification group from the Ayurvedic Nighantus (e.g. Haritaki Varga).
entries.label: Varga

entries.text: Veerya: Ayurvedic potency — Ushna (hot) or Sheeta (cold) (Dravyaguna).
entries.label: Veerya

entries.text: Vipaka: Ayurvedic post-digestive effect (Dravyaguna).
entries.label: Vipaka

entries.text: belongs to varga (PlantSpecies -> Varga): A medicinal plant belongs to a Varga (classification group). Cardinality: one or more — may appear in multiple Nighantus. Source: AyurAhaar Varga field.
entries.label: belongs to varga

entries.text: has dosha action (PlantSpecies -> DoshaAction): A medicinal plant has a Dosha Action, pointing to a cphr:DoshaAction node specifying which Dosha and how (Shamaka/Vardhaka). Cardinality: many — one per Dosha affected.
entries.label: has dosha action

entries.text: has guna (PlantSpecies -> Guna): A medicinal plant has a Guna (quality). Cardinality: many, typically 2-4 per plant. Source: AyurAhaar Guna field.
entries.label: has guna

entries.text: has karma (PlantSpecies -> Karma): What therapeutic action or medicinal effect this plant has (its Karma). Cardinality: many. Source: AyurAhaar Karma field; standard alignment Charaka Samhita.
entries.label: has karma

entries.text: has rasa (PlantSpecies -> Rasa): A medicinal plant has a Rasa (taste). Cardinality: many — e.g. Haritaki carries all six. Source: AyurAhaar Rasa field.
entries.label: has rasa

entries.text: has used part (PlantSpecies -> PlantPart): A medicinal plant has a used part. Cardinality: one or more — e.g. root and leaf both used. Source: AyurAhaar Part field.
entries.label: has used part

entries.text: has veerya (PlantSpecies -> Veerya): A medicinal plant has a Veerya (potency). Cardinality: exactly 1 — either Ushna or Sheeta. Source: AyurAhaar Veerya field.
entries.label: has veerya

entries.text: has vipaka (PlantSpecies -> Vipaka): A medicinal plant has a Vipaka (post-digestive effect). Cardinality: exactly 1, one of three values. Source: AyurAhaar Vipaka field.
entries.label: has vipaka

entries.text: on dosha (DoshaAction -> Dosha): A Dosha Action acts on a Dosha (Vata/Pitta/Kapha). Paired with cphr:actionType to form the complete statement.
entries.label: on dosha

entries.text: action type (property of DoshaAction): Direction of effect on the dosha. Cardinality: exactly 1. Allowed values: "Shamaka" (reduces) or "Vardhaka" (increases). Key filter in dosha queries. Standard alignment: Dravyaguna.
entries.label: action type

entries.text: color (property of PlantSpecies): Visual color of the ingredient used for identification. Cardinality: one or more. Source: AyurAhaar Color filter field.
entries.label: color

entries.text: description (property of PlantSpecies): Free-text summary of the plant's Ayurvedic significance and primary uses. Cardinality: 1.
entries.label: description

entries.text: family (property of PlantSpecies): Botanical family, e.g. Combretaceae. Enables browsing by plant family.
entries.label: family

entries.text: genus (property of PlantSpecies): Genus name. Enables search by genus across species.
entries.label: genus

entries.text: hindi name (property of PlantSpecies): Common Hindi name(s). Cardinality: one or more. Source: AyurAhaar common name field.
entries.label: hindi name

entries.text: IPNI ID (property of PlantSpecies): International Plant Names Index identifier. Links to authoritative botanical name registry. Cardinality: 1.
entries.label: IPNI ID

entries.text: is traded in India (property of PlantSpecies): Whether commercially traded in India per Goraya & Ved 2017 dataset. Cardinality: 1. Standard alignment: tradedmedicinalplants.org.
entries.label: is traded in India

entries.text: karma category (property of Karma): Broad therapeutic grouping for a karma. Cardinality: 1. Allowed values: Digestive / Rejuvenative / Neurological / Anti-inflammatory / Respiratory / Cardiovascular / Detoxification / Anti-infective / Urinary. Standard alignment: AyurBio.
entries.label: karma category

entries.text: kingdom (property of PlantSpecies): Always "Plantae" for this dataset.
entries.label: kingdom

entries.text: order (property of PlantSpecies): Botanical order, e.g. Myrtales.
entries.label: order

entries.text: sanskrit name (property of PlantSpecies): Name as it appears in classical Sanskrit texts. Cardinality: one or more — a plant may have multiple Sanskrit synonyms. Standard alignment: Dravyaguna.
entries.label: sanskrit name

entries.text: scientific name (property of PlantSpecies): Full scientific name with authorship, e.g. Terminalia chebula Retz. Source: tradedmedicinalplants.org.
entries.label: scientific name

entries.text: specific epithet (property of PlantSpecies): Species epithet (second part of the binomial name).
entries.label: specific epithet

entries.text: trade name (property of PlantSpecies): Market / commercial name used in the Indian herbal trade. Cardinality: one or more. Source: tradedmedicinalplants.org.
entries.label: trade name

entries.text: vernacular name (property of PlantSpecies): Common name in any regional language (Hindi, Tamil, Kannada etc.). Cardinality: many. Enables local-language search.
entries.label: vernacular name

entries.text: WCVP ID (property of PlantSpecies): World Checklist of Vascular Plants identifier. Enables alignment with APG taxonomy. Cardinality: 1. Standard alignment: WCVP / Kew.
entries.label: WCVP ID
